Regime classification

get_market_regime()

The market-wide context computed first — it sets the BUY-score floor and size cap for every ticker downstream. Principle 18: regime detection IS the strategy.

SPY vs EMA50 / SMA200 QQQ vs EMA50 VIX level · slope · term structure Breadth % above 50DMA

risk_on_trending BULL

SPY > EMA50 & SMA200
QQQ > EMA50 · VIX < 20 · breadth > 60%
BUY floor 65max size 100%

risk_on_choppy NEUTRAL

SPY > EMA50 but not all criteria met
the default / fall-through regime
BUY floor 72max size 70%

risk_off_trending BEAR

SPY closed below EMA50 for 2 consecutive sessions
(risk_off_consecutive_closes)
BUY floor 78max size 35%

panic BEAR

VIX > 35 OR breadth < 20%
BUY floor —max size 0% (no longs)
Hysteresis + downgrades: a 2-bar buffer (VIX enter 22 / exit 18, breadth 53/47) prevents whipsaw, then three post-classification gates only ever de-risk — VIX-dynamics (backwardation/slope), distribution-days (IBD 5+), and an HMM return-shape blend. Regime is anchored to the last completed daily bar and never flipped intraday.

Universe funnel — what gets analyzed

swing_trade.py:1058 → 1556

A wide candidate union narrowed by liquidity gates and an enrichment cap. Picking ≠ scoring — this only decides which names enter the scoring engine. always_include (held + recent past-picks) bypasses every filter for track-record continuity.

Portfolio-blind: per the signal_layer_portfolio_blind design the candidate set is universe-wide — it is never filtered by the owner's own holdings or signal_log, because signals serve a 500+ user base.

5-pillar scoring

analyze_ticker() · analysis.py:9497

Each qualified ticker runs four scorers producing raw points, normalized to 100. Weights are set by SCORING_MODE (currently swing_optimized): catalyst boosted, fundamentals cut, because quarterly metrics don't predict weekly price action.

3

Verdict cascade — single source of truth

compute_final_verdict() · decision_engine.py:962

A strict ordered cascade. First failure wins. Replaced the old "whichever engine wrote last" behavior — no tab ever recomputes a verdict. Every output ships with a full gates_evaluated audit trail.

System kill switches→ WAIT:1003
Circuit breaker · forced-cash mode · macro blackout (FOMC/CPI). Bear setup or direction=short → AVOID.
Repeat-entry cooldown→ WATCHportfolio-blind: skipped:1041
Same ticker stopped out < 5d ago — no chasing (principle 8). Reads owner's signal_log, so skipped when the signal layer is portfolio-blind.
Regime gate (A3)→ WATCHbypass: Defensive · PEAD · Insider · ESP:1094
No new longs in risk_off_trending / panic — bull-only strategy per 750d backtest. Catalyst sleeves bypass (alpha is regime-independent).
Momentum-condition gate→ WATCH:1129
Trend Continuation + Breakout demoted when QQQ−SPY 21d spread < 0 — pure-momentum factor plays with zero alpha (P2 attribution).
Rolling-Sharpe kill→ WATCHcatalyst sleeves bypass:1149
Pause new BUYs when rolling Sharpe of recent closed BUYs < floor. Capital-preservation gate.
Hard gates ×6WATCH / WAIT_eval_hard_gates :1226
liquidity_price · multi_timeframe · entry_quality · decision_state · tail_loss_filter · fundamental_adequacy (≥50%) · sector blocklist · Wilson-gated setup_kill_list. Failures in {entry_quality, decision_state, multi_timeframe} → WATCH; others → WAIT. Catalyst sleeves bypass entry_quality / decision_state / tail-loss / fund.
Ranking threshold→ BUY:1251
score ≥ regime BUY floor (65 / 72 / 78) → BUY, after a final signal_filter whitelist check (OFF by default). Gates pass but score below floor → WATCH.
BUY

All gates passed and score clears the regime floor. Sized by conviction tier.

WATCH

Strong but waiting — entry extended, score below floor, or a soft demotion. Monitor.

WAIT

Structural reject — liquidity, fundamentals, or a system kill switch.

AVOID

Bear setup / short direction. Not a long candidate.

Flow: regime → universe funnel → 5-pillar scoring + classification → verdict cascade → BUY / WATCH / WAIT / AVOID
